lines.text: God put into the heart of Titus the same devotion Paul has, and Titus is eagerly coming to Corinth.
Paul sends with Titus a brother praised by all the churches for his work in the temple.
Paul wants to avoid criticism of how the gift is administered and takes care to do right before the Lord and men.
Paul boasted to the Macedonians that since last year the Corinthians in Galatia were prepared to give.
Paul urges the brothers to visit Corinth beforehand so the promised gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.
